svg.title: Engineering reference - source page 73
svg.desc: Energy collection → heat upgrading → heat delivery. Key: 能量采集系统 = source-energy collection; 能量提升系统 = heat upgrading; 能量释放系统 = heat delivery; 压缩机 = compressor; 冷凝器 = condenser; 蒸发器 = evaporator; 膨胀阀 = expansion valve. Source/load pumps circulate water to indoor terminals or hot-water storage.
